g.text: Distributed inductance and capacitance set a lossless line’s wave speed and impedance

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Differential segment of uniform lossless two-conductor line, R′=G′=0; lower conductor is the reference return. Forward wave current is referenced in+z and
in phase with voltage: i⁺=v⁺/Z₀. Plots are100 MHz,t=0 snapshots with10 V and0.2 A amplitudes. Backward wave would have i⁻=−v⁻/Z₀ under the same current
reference. Segment values scale byΔz; L′/C′ are per unit length, not lumped totals.
